reviews.text: Great sleep aid for those with tinnitus. Great sleep aid for those with tinnitus - if one can cancel those damned obnoxious ads.

Was GREAT until update!. This app worked beautifully for YEARS!!! I could turn it on and it would play ocean sounds all night long. After a recent update, It no longer works the same way. I try to schedule it to play for 12 hours and it will turn off after an hour. It used to always remember that I wanted it to play for an extended amount of time, now I have to set it at that time EACH night before bed. Please go back to the way it was before! Update: I have been using this app for almost a year, I can’t believe they added talking ads. I use this for nap time at the preschool, now when I tuen it on sometimes it talks and I have to wait a while to close the ad. That is not okay, every minute can be precious or stressful when working with kids, I don’t have time to wait around for an ad to end while beginning nap time. ): I love this app, I use it while the kids sleep at the preschool I work at. I love how it doesn’t need internet and jow it plays in the background! HOWVEVER, when I try to use other apps while the waves are playing, sometimes it turns off or allows other sound to play. This app should override all other apps or else what is the point ? Some apps that turn off the waves: camera, iMessage when click on send photo, Elevate, posting on Instagram Apps that play over the waves: Instagram and LinkedIn This is just from my experience, I’m sure there’s more apps that interfere with the waves. I feel very, very restricted when using the wave app after the children fall asleep. I’ve also reached out to Instagram about this problem. It would be so nice to hear the waves while I use other apps!! (: (WOW! After reading reviews, I’m SO GLAD they fixed the ad problem because that would completely ruin the app, it’s like those relaxing YouTube videos who put ad stamps in their videos and try to wake up my kids up at nap time, why?? Was that their plan all along? haha.)

So I leave it and can’t sleep on vacation so I was looking for a good app to use to substitute the machine. And I looked at three and this was by far the best.
